import random,time,importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('s','/workspace/submission/main.py')
s=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(s)
for mode in range(4):
  m=64
  factors=[]
  random.seed(10+mode)
  for i in range(m):
    if mode==0:
      vs=(i,)
    elif mode==1:
      vs=tuple(x for x in (i-1,i,i+1) if 0<=x<m)
    elif mode==2:
      vs=tuple(x for x in (i-2,i-1,i,i+1,i+2) if 0<=x<m)
    else:
      vs=(i,)+tuple(x for x in range(max(0,i-4),min(m,i+5)) if x!=i)[:4]
    size=3**len(vs)
    vals=[random.randint(0,1000000) for _ in range(size)]
    factors.append((vs,vals))
  pos=list(range(m)) # identity elimination; graph path band width maybe
  t=time.time(); z=s.run_ve(factors,m,pos); t1=time.time()
  for i in range(1): 
    for tstate in range(3): s.run_ve(factors,m,pos,(i,tstate))
  t2=time.time()
  print('mode',mode,'m',m,'Zdigits',len(str(z)),'base',t1-t,'4runs',t2-t1)
PY
